headline: Block Faces $764 Million DOJ Settlement as Bitcoin Gross Profit Halves
summary: Block is facing a proposed $764 million DOJ settlement to resolve a federal anti-money-laundering investigation. Meanwhile, lower Cash App trading fees caused the company's quarterly bitcoin gross profit to plunge by 50%.
why: Block operates payment platforms including Cash App and is a prominent player in financial technology and bitcoin services.

impacts.name: Block Inc
impacts.why: Potential fine and drop in bitcoin gross profit directly impact the company's financial standing.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A large regulatory settlement and sharply lower profit from bitcoin trading directly affect the company's valuation and earnings outlook.
